mainEntity.name: What is the difference between open riser and closed riser deck stairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open riser stairs have gaps between the treads, offering a more airy and modern look, and allowing light to pass through. Closed riser stairs have vertical boards (risers) between each tread, creating a solid appearance and often feeling more secure, especially for homes with small children or pets. Practical Tradeoff: Open risers can reduce material costs and create an open feel, but may not meet code requirements in all areas without specific design considerations for safety. Closed risers provide a traditional, solid structure and can offer additional storage underneath.
acceptedAnswer.description: Open riser stairs have gaps between treads for an airy look, while closed riser stairs have solid risers, offering a traditional feel and potentially more safety. Both have material and aesthetic tradeoffs.
